title: Continuation and missing work
summary: Advance WebSocket by filling protocol and carrier-composition gaps while preserving the common socket authority and exact evidence boundaries.
invariants: First rerun the dev1 contract and live independent-COTS tests against the current Socket Provider baseline before claiming fresh compatibility.
Bind production nonce and masking entropy to an estate cryptographic/randomness authority; do not add shell-command crypto or ad-hoc weak randomness.
Complete fragmented multi-frame message reassembly and qualify control-frame interleaving before advertising complete fragmentation semantics.
Add extension negotiation only through explicit extension objects and fail closed for unsupported negotiated extensions.
Treat RFC 8441 and RFC 9220 as explicit WebSocket-over-HTTP/2 and WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 compositions; do not pretend ordinary RFC 6455 HTTP/1.1 Upgrade implements them.
Keep browser, Queue Fabric, RPC, Wire UI and application semantics above WebSocket. They may consume the access class but must not become owners of RFC 6455 framing.
Preserve full ooRexx objects through every selector/provider seam; do not flatten addresses, messages or authorities into dictionaries merely for convenience.
